ModMetaData.name: PickleTools - research window steps (shared)
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Reusable Pickle steps that open a tab of the research window by def name, by label or by translation key, and read what it lists. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See PickleTools/ResearchSteps/README.md at the repository root.
